advancedperipherals.name: Advanced Peripherals
advancements.advancedperipherals.base_to: Collect a redstone integrator, inventory manager and energy detector. How did you even play without this?
advancements.advancedperipherals.end_aut: If you can code gps-free position location with this, you're a powerful human being
advancements.advancedperipherals.nbt_too: Collect a NBT storage and block reader. Now, all the world's secrets are open to you!
advancements.advancedperipherals.overpow: Can you handle so much power?
advancements.advancedperipherals.root.de: Every journey starts with the first block
advancements.advancedperipherals.sense_t: Collect a geo scanner and environmental detector. There are no limits for observability!
advancements.advancedperipherals.weak_au: Does the afterlife exist in minecraft?
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.block_: &7Reads nbt data of blocks to interact with blocks which do not have computer support.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.chat_b: &7Interacts with the ingame chat, can read and write messages.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.colony: &7Interacts with Minecolonies to read data about your colony and citizens.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.distan: &7Measure the distance to the first obstruction.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.energy: &7Can detect energy flow and acts as a resistor.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.enviro: &7This peripheral interacts with the minecraft world.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.fluid_: &7Can detect fluid flow and acts as a resistor.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.gas_de: &7Can detect gas flow and acts as a resistor.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.geo_sc: &7Scans the area around it to find some shiny ores.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.invent: &7This block is able to send or receive specific items from a player inventory.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.me_bri: &7The ME Bridge interacts with Applied Energistics to manage your items.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.nbt_st: &7Acts like a storage disk. Can store nbt based data.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.periph: &7An empty hull without the love it deserves. Used as crafting ingredient
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.player: &7This peripheral can be used to interact with players, but don't be a stalker.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.rs_bri: &7The RS Bridge interacts with Refined Storage to manage your items.
block.advancedperipherals.tooltip.smart_: &7An advanced rail that can be controlled by computer.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.ae_disk: &7Provides some more external file storage via ME Bridge.
&7Provides a bit external file storage via ME Bridge.
&7Provides a lot external file storage via ME Bridge.
&7Provides some external file storage via ME Bridge.
&7Provides even more external file storage via ME Bridge.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.chunk_c: &7A crafting ingredient for the Chunky Turtle.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.compute: &7This tool was made to tune our blocks. But for now, it's just a blue useless wrench.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.disable: &cThis item is disabled in config, so you can craft it, but it'll not have any functionality.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.end_aut: &7Upgrade for turtles, that allows basic interaction with the world and teleportation in one dimension.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.hotkey_: &7Capture a predefined key and forward it as an event.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.husband: &7Upgrade for turtles, that allows basic and advanced interactions with animals.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.keyboar: &7Control a computer remotely, or intercept player inputs to smartglasses.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.memory_: &7Can save the rights of a player to use it in an inventory manager.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.nightvi: &7Give wearer better view of the world.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.overpow: &7Improved version of the end automata core, that provides some overpowered uses! Be careful, the upgrade is very fragile.
&7Improved version of the husbandry automata core, that provides some overpowered uses! Be careful, the upgrade is very fragile.
&7Improved version of the weak automata core, that provides some overpowered uses! Be careful, the upgrade is very fragile.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.smart_g: &7A portable computer that supports multiple peripherals and modules.
&7Can access equipped smart glasses without taking it off!
&7An upgraded version of smart glasses that provides a bit more armor.
item.advancedperipherals.tooltip.weak_au: &7Upgrade for turtles, which makes turtles more useful.
text.advancedperipherals.automata_core.f: You're trying to feed an entity to a soul, but your own body refuses to do this. Maybe something more mechanical can do this?
text.advancedperipherals.bind_memorycard: Bounded the memory card to you
text.advancedperipherals.keyboard.close: Press ESC to close the Keyboard Screen
